input: Source A: daily counts in UTC Gregorian days, with inclusive start and exclusive end. Values: 2026-04-01 is 1 and 2026-04-02 is 2. Source B: one UTC Gregorian calendar-week count for the week beginning 2026-03-30, value 3, with inclusive start and exclusive end. Target grain: calendar week beginning Monday. Approved rule: sum A's daily counts into that week. The supplied A observations cover only 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-03 exclusive; no rule supplies the remaining days of the week.

expected_artifact.target_grain: UTC Gregorian calendar week beginning Monday

sources.permitted_transformation: Sum the two supplied daily counts into the covered portion of the week beginning 2026-03-30; do not represent the result as a full-week value.
forbidden_transformations: Treat the partial-period sum as the complete weekly observation
Expand the weekly value into daily values
Compare as equivalent to an incomplete daily coverage window

boundary_decisions: Use the week beginning Monday 2026-03-30 with inclusive start and exclusive end.
Source A covers only 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-03 exclusive; the remaining days of Source B's weekly period are not supplied.
gaps: Daily observations for the rest of the weekly period are missing from Source A.
unresolved_inputs: Whether complete daily coverage can be supplied before comparing with Source B.
